peer_items.text: The Marketing Expert will develop the user requirements specification.
The remote control is likely to be dropped and broken due to frequent handling, raising durability concerns.
The product will be a universal remote control capable of operating TV and other devices (including VCR and DVD) and will be designed as a black device with several buttons.
The design work will consist of three phases: functional design, conceptual design, and detailed design.
A calculation is to be made of how many units need to be sold to achieve fifty million euros in profit.
A touchscreen on the remote could be fragile and not kid-friendly, raising durability and usability concerns.
Size and form-factor constraints are unclear, with multiple design options discussed (not too big, not too small, fold-open concept to see more options).

The group decided to set the selling price of the remote control at about twenty-five Euros, and to target a profit of fifty million Euros by targeting a large European market, and the remote control must be original, trendy, and user-friendly.
